mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.5% in the last month signals a tightening monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate investment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances when the trigger condition is met, or if the correlation between FEDFUNDS increases and negative returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate by more than 0.3 percentage points in the last month signals weakening labor market conditions, which leads to reduced consumer spending and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances when the trigger condition is met, or if the correlation between UNRATE increases and negative returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) over the last three months indicates weakening consumer demand, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances when RSAFS shows a decline, or if the correlation between RSAFS declines and negative returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% in the last month signals a strengthening supply side, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances when the trigger condition is met, or if the correlation between INDPRO increases and positive returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 200,000 in the last month, it signals a strong labor market, which boosts consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances when the trigger condition is met, or if the correlation between PAYEMS increases and positive returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in housing starts (HOUST) and real GDP (GDPC1) over the last three months signals a strengthening demand side, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances when both proxies show an increase, or if the joint correlation between HOUST and GDPC1 increases and positive returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4% and the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) increases by more than 0.5% in the last month, it signals inflationary pressure combined with tight monetary policy, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS > 4% and CPIAUCSL increases > 0.5% in 1 month
regime_hint: inflationary pressure with tight monetary policy
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances when the trigger condition is met, or if the joint correlation between the trigger conditions and negative returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.2 percentage points in the last month, combined with an increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 100,000, signals a strengthening labor market, which boosts consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE decreases > 0.2pp and PAYEMS increases > 100k in 1 month
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances when the trigger condition is met, or if the joint correlation between the trigger conditions and positive returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).
